## Carrier Provider Exchange

Provider Exchange is built on enhanced cloud peering with Zoom. It is built to make it easier for provider discovery and self-service of phone numbers by Zoom customers. Using the _Carrier Provider Exchange_ apps built by the peering partners, these partners can integrate their number management systems to directly push and offer ongoing number management for their customers.
